newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech parl't agrees Basta to head Kreditni probe.
newsitem.headline: Czech parl't agrees Basta to head Kreditni probe.

text.p: The lower house of the Czech parliament on Friday elected opposition Social Democrat Jaroslav Basta to chair the special commission investigating the recent failure of Kreditni Banka a.s..
Basta heads parliament's intelligence services oversight committee and was a former official in the Interior Ministry..

Parliament agreed to create the 12-member commission last week after pressure from the opposition angry at the loss of about two billion crowns deposited by the state Customs Administration at Kreditni Banka.
The commission is to report its findings by the end of February next year.
The central bank rescinded Kreditni's banking licence in August following a series of failed loans and debt swaps which led to an estimated 12 billion crowns in total losses.
A total of eight suspects connected to Kreditni Banka have been charges on various counts of fraud and embezzlement.
Kreditni and Agrobanka were the 11th and 12th troubled banks respectively in which the central bank had intervened in the post-Communist era.
